name: Graphs
description: Run a procedure written as a graph of agents, commands, questions and waits, kept on disk after every step so it survives a restart. A graph does nothing until you enable its exact definition in the Graphs panel, and it runs while Ostia is open.

maxSteps.description: The ceiling a graph's limits.steps may not pass

maxRunsPerHour.description: The ceiling a graph's limits.runsPerHour may not pass

maxParallel.title: Nodes running at once per run, at most
maxParallel.description: The ceiling a graph's limits.parallel may not pass

maxAgentsPerRun.title: Agents started per run, at most
maxAgentsPerRun.description: The ceiling a graph's limits.agents may not pass

maxRunHours.title: Hours per run, at most
maxRunHours.description: The ceiling a graph's limits.time may not pass

connections.title: HTTP API
connections.description: An API a graph's http connector calls: requests stay under its base URL, never on another host or a path outside it

baseUrl.title: Base URL
baseUrl.description: Where requests go, such as https://api.example.com/v1, without user:password@; a node's path is added under it

header.title: Header name
header.description: For header authentication, such as X-Api-Key

secret.title: Token or password
secret.description: Sent with every request of this connection; never in a graph file
